items.title: Cernavodă Unit 1 shut down
items.text: On 27 July Nuclearelectrica announced a controlled shutdown of Unit 1 on 28 July "due to the very low, unprecedented water level of the Danube caused by severe drought".

items.title: Riverbed blasting to cool the last reactor
items.text: The Ministry of National Defence confirmed 102 military personnel, including navy EOD divers, made a controlled detonation in the Bala branch riverbed to steer water to Cernavodă's remaining cooling intake.
items.source: Romanian Ministry of National Defence, press release 157

items.title: Flow at less than half the August average
items.text: Copernicus reported Danube flow at the Romanian border of about 1,600 m³/s against a multiannual August average of about 3,900 m³/s.
items.source: Copernicus / EU Space, Image of the Day

items.title: Shipping effectively blocked
items.text: The river captaincy reported larger vessels stationary in ports and small-draft ships passing with difficulty; normal navigation needed another 80 cm to 1 m of water.

items.title: Fire in dried-out Delta vegetation
items.text: About 700 hectares of dry vegetation burned on Babina Island on 17-18 August.

items.title: ARBDD restricts fishing and navigation
items.text: With the Danube at Tulcea down to 12 cm, ARBDD banned set-net fishing and imposed low-speed navigation on Delta channels, citing grounding risk, bank erosion and harm to habitats and bird colonies.
